rollback.sql: create table enterprise_identity_connections ( connection_id uuid primary key, tenant_id uuid not null references tenants(id), provider_id varchar(100) not null, provider_type varchar(20) not null, display_name varchar(200) not null, issuer_uri varchar(1000) not null, browser_client_id varchar(300), api_audience varchar(300) not null, secret_reference varchar(500), status varchar(20) not null, configuration_version bigint not null, created_at timestamptz not null, updated_at timestamptz not null, last_tested_at timestamptz, last_test_status varchar(20), last_test_message varchar(500), constraint ck_eic_provider_type check (provider_type in ('OIDC','SAML','LDAP_AD')), constraint ck_eic_status check (status in ('DRAFT','VALIDATED','ACTIVE','DISABLED')), constraint ck_eic_version check (configuration_version > 0), constraint ck_eic_test_status check (last_test_status is null or last_test_status in ('PASSED','FAILED')) ); create unique index uq_eic_active_binding on enterprise_identity_connections(provider_id, issuer_uri, api_audience) where status='ACTIVE'; create index ix_eic_active_lookup on enterprise_identity_connections(provider_id, issuer_uri, api_audience) where status='ACTIVE'; create unique index uq_eic_staged_per_tenant_provider on enterprise_identity_connections(tenant_id) where status in ('DRAFT','VALIDATED'); create unique index uq_eic_active_per_tenant on enterprise_identity_connections(tenant_id) where status='ACTIVE';
